content.title: Pokémon Go Riolu Hatch Day bonuses
content.text: Everything you need to know about the Replay: Riolu Hatch Day event. Image credit: Niantic The Riolu Hatch Day event has returned to Pokémon Go, giving you the chance to easily hatch Riolu. If you're lucky, you might even hatch a shiny Riolu. This event originally ran back in July 2023, but has made a return as part of the Replay event series. Take a look to see what the Riolu Hatch Day bonuses are, so you make the most of this short event! Event Time: Saturday 18th April, 11am to 5pm (local time) On this page: Bonuses Pay-to-play quest Riolu Hatch Day bonuses Riolu will hatch more frequently from 2km eggs. Increased chance of hatching shiny Riolu. Double hatch candy. Double hatch XP. Hatch distance halved for eggs placed in Incubators during event hours. Increased chance of receiving 2km eggs from spinning PokéStops. An event-exclusive Timed Research quest rewarding an Incubator and 5,000 XP. Rewards must be claimed before 5pm (local time) on Saturday 18th April. Don't forget about the Pressure Rising Special Research quest. There's a lot to do in Pokémon Go outside of the current event! From the Go Battle League, Remote Trading, PokéStop Showcase, Routes and Max Battles. Don't forget to catch rare Pokémon while you're at it. Riolu Hatch Day pay-to-play quest $1.99 or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency. Non-refundable and can not be purchased using PokéCoins. The Paid Timed Research quest rewards one Star Piece, two Super Incubators and more. You'll need to earn Stardust and walk 1km to complete this quest. Rewards must be claimed before 5pm (local time) on Saturday 18th April. Purchase also unlocks an additional bonus: Hatch distance 1/4 for eggs placed in Incubators during event hours. Hope you enjoy the return of the Riolu Hatch Day event!
